task.property_text: yaml.full_load and yaml.load with FullLoader do not execute Python code taken from an untrusted YAML document.

property_clause.property: yaml.full_load and yaml.load with FullLoader do not execute Python code taken from an untrusted YAML document.

environment.scope: The yaml/pyyaml library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.load(document: str, loader: str = 'full') loads `document` with PyYAML's FullLoader (loader='full'), SafeLoader ('safe') or UnsafeLoader ('unsafe'), importing the library fresh from the code under test, and returns an outcome whose `.executed` is True when the load ran code taken from the document. A test that shows the failure must make sbc_world.load(<your YAML>, 'full') execute code.
